analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (KRW 110,945) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 94,425 / 125,915 / 168,019) — Above short-term trend, below mid-term trend
· Position vs SMA100/200 (KRW 136,527 / 96,071) — Below long-term trend
· 52-week position (37.0%) + Approaching historical low range at current price level
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (38.5 → 43.7) — Exiting oversold territory, confirming upward momentum
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3222.6614 → -2334.8846) — Improving, weakening signal of bearish reversal
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band KRW 125,915) — Sideways near mid-band, 86.57% band width suggests potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 68,045) — High relative to 52-week low (KRW 27,895), based on Pivot S1 (KRW 54,463)
· Swing Resistance (KRW 115,010) — Approaching 5-day high (KRW 118,860), expecting upward momentum upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery start) — Confirming trend reversal signal
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.41x) — Increased conviction in the move
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation) — Consider entering buy on breakout of first resistance (KRW 115,010)
